content.description: Intersect is where decisions are made, voices are heard, and positive change becomes possible. Our members create a secure, collaborative environment that supports Cardano’s continued growth and evolution-ensuring progress happens in a trusted and inclusive space. Maintaining Cardano’s core technology and shaping its future roadmap brings together a diverse range of stakeholders. 19 min April 10 April 9, 2026 The 2026 Constitutional Committee Elections The Cardano ecosystem is approaching what is becoming a yearly tradition in governance.
